result.summary: Found 1 issue: a minor styling inconsistency in the heart/favorite icon styling between two similar cards.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has a white circular background, while the heart icon on the pizza card below it has a dark/black circular background, creating visual inconsistency between similar card components.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button styling (background color/opacity) across all promotional cards for visual consistency.
